1.en: The school will conduct a survey about lunch options.
1.zh: 学校将开展一项关于午餐选择的调查。

9.en: The forthcoming report will include the latest figures.
9.zh: 即将发布的报告将包含最新数据。

13.en: No one could foresee how quickly the town would grow.
13.zh: 没人能预见这座小镇会发展得这么快。

14.en: A supervisor will oversee the repair work.
14.zh: 一名主管将监督维修工作。

22.en: The new law protects everyone's liberty to speak freely.
22.zh: 新法律保护每个人自由表达的权利。

25.en: They made a deliberate choice to walk instead of drive.
25.zh: 他们经过慎重考虑，决定步行而不开车。

28.en: The only means of reaching the island is by boat.
28.zh: 到达这座岛的唯一方式是乘船。

30.en: The museum is a trusted authority on local history.
30.zh: 这家博物馆是研究当地历史的权威机构。

31.en: The shop sells authentic handmade pottery.
31.zh: 这家商店出售真正的手工陶器。

38.en: Safety is our top priority during the trip.
38.zh: 旅途中，安全是我们的首要事项。

47.en: The two teams reached a mutual agreement.
47.zh: 两个团队达成了共同协议。

62.en: Someone hacked into my email account.
62.zh: 有人侵入了我的电子邮箱账户。
